name: browser
description: DEPRECATED — the browser plugin now ships from its own repository, https://github.com/5dive-ai/5dive-browser (`sudo 5dive plugin add 5dive-ai/5dive-browser`). This copy still resolves and still installs, because boxes provisioned before the move name it today — but it is frozen and receives no fixes. A box already carrying it migrates in two commands: `sudo 5dive plugin remove browser@5dive-plugins`, then the add above (the CLI refuses two plugins claiming the `browser` verb). Persistent human-authenticated browser sessions — log into a site once by hand, then let deterministic adapters operate it. Never solves a security challenge; it stops and asks you.

verbs.name: browser
verbs.summary: log into a site once, then let adapters operate it

setup.hint: browser needs a root-created profile store that 5dive will not create behind your back, and a Chrome on the box.
